name: betweenness_centrality
author: 98eff80e
description: Computes exact shortest-path betweenness centrality using Ulrik Brandes' algorithm. Identifies key brokers, bridges, and bottleneck nodes that control information flow across groups. Supports directed and undirected, unweighted (hop-based BFS) and weighted (distance-based Dijkstra) graphs. Returns top_k nodes ranked by betweenness score with node labels.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Number of highest-ranked nodes to return.

normalized.description: If true, normalize scores by the number of possible node pairs.

weighted.description: If true, use edge weights as path distances (Dijkstra); if false, count hop count (BFS).

endpoints.description: If true, include source and target endpoints in shortest path counts.
